entries.name: Taima Particles
entries.content:
Taima Particles, they are also called Anti Demon Particles or just Particles, they are a substance that serves as the basis of a Taimanin's power.

The Taima particles can be imbued to one's body, clothes or weapon, to enhance the offensive and defensive capabilities; it can be transformed into energy that enables superhuman feats and supernatural abilities. They're constantly surrounding Taimanin, and their concentration suddenly rise when they invoke their ninja arts. They also are known to have a negative effect on Demons. This power was in the past just called "Ki" without any scientific understanding. Particles are required to use a number of the General Ninja Techniques and unique Ninja Arts, Taimanin are known for.
